scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you have something to say to him,
just talk to me.
You won't even understand what stupid pumkin headed Jack is saying.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
如果你有什么话想对他说，
就跟我讲吧。
你甚至听不懂那个愚蠢的南瓜头杰克在说什么。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务
存放一些物品后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh wait, is that a Pumpkin Mojo you are carrying?
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哦等等，你身上带着南瓜的精髓吗？
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Give it to me. I'll pay you back.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
I just can guess what he will say next. So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
把它给我。我会给你报酬的。
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的……
我大概能猜到他接下来要说什么。你怎么看？

scripts.text: What will he say?
scripts.translation: 他会说什么？

scripts.text: I also know about it.
scripts.translation: 我也知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What will he say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他会说什么？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Jack is not like others. He is halloween Jack.
but one day, he lost his Pumpkin Mojo and turned into depressed Jack..
Pumpkin Mojo was his all.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
杰克和别人不一样。他是万圣节杰克。
但有一天，他弄丢了南瓜的精髓，变成了沮丧的杰克……
南瓜的精髓就是他的一切。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, actually that's the main reason Jack came to town.
To find his Pumpkin Mojo. Most suspicious suspect is ^4d4dffDelightful Lude^000000, the one known as Halloween monster
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嗯，其实这就是杰克来到城镇的主要原因。
为了找到他的南瓜的精髓。最可疑的嫌疑人是^4d4dff兴奋的杰克^000000，也就是被称为万圣节魔物的那家伙。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Why don't you give him back the 'Pumpkin Mojo'.
Don't worry he will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
你为什么不把‘南瓜的精髓’还给他呢。
别担心，他会补偿你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compensate?With what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
补偿？用什么补偿？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you bring ^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo^000000 and a pumpkin head that we gave out to you last year,
he will make it to ^00ff00the most fantastic pumpkin hat^000000.
Or if you don't have pumpkin head, you can just bring a ^3d3dff Pumpkin Mojo, a pumpkin, and a cap ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
如果你带来^4d4dff 1个南瓜的精髓^000000和去年我们发给你的南瓜头，
他会把它做成^00ff00最棒的南瓜帽^000000。
或者如果你没有南瓜头，你可以只带^3d3dff一个南瓜的精髓、一个南瓜和一顶帽子^000000来。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, that Pumpkin Mojo is useless if you just carry it. 
Give it to Jack. Don't you feel pity for him?.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嗯，那个南瓜的精髓如果你只是带着也没什么用。
把它给杰克吧。你不觉得他很可怜吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~Great.
Then, let me see what you got.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
哦~太好了。
那么，让我看看你有什么。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh, you brought the pumpkin head!
I'll make you to nicer one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哦，你带来了南瓜头！
我会给你做一个更好的。
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍后再来。

scripts.text: Oh, good. Make it now!
scripts.translation: 哦，好的。现在就做吧！

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Huh?
 
[Cool Devi]
What? Look at Jack. He has got so dissapointed.
Promise me to give the Pumpkin Mojo back to Jack later someday, will you?
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哈？
 
[酷黛维]
什么？看看杰克。他非常失望。
答应我以后某天会把南瓜的精髓还给杰克，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Thanks for giving my thing back, I'll make your hat prettier.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
谢谢你把我的东西还给我，我会把你的帽子做得更漂亮。
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Excited Jack]
Lalala~ lalala~
 
(He starts singing. On a sudden, Jack's aura appeared.)
scripts.translation:
[兴奋的杰克]
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦~
 
（他开始唱歌。突然，杰克的<死亡骑士>灵气出现了。）

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
My aura is not like it used to be. Maybe I need more Pumpkin Mojo.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
我的<死亡骑士>灵气不如以前了。也许我需要更多的南瓜的精髓。
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的……

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~poor Jack.
Well, someday he'll get back all his Pumpkin Mojo back.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
哦~可怜的杰克。
嗯，总有一天他会找回所有的南瓜的精髓。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Wow!
I'll turn your hat to very cool one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哇！
我会把你的帽子变成非常酷的样子。
 
[酷黛维]

Hey,there. You don't seem to have all materials for the fantastic hat.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嘿，你好。你似乎没有制作那顶奇妙帽子所需的所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Hey,there. Why don't you come here and listen to my story.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
嘿，你好。为什么不过来听听我的故事呢。
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
I used to be very famous. But now.....
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
Well, I'll just tell you without translating.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
我曾经非常有名。但现在……
 
[酷黛维]
他是这么说的……
嗯，我就直接告诉你，不翻译了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Pumpkin is the gift that God had sent us.
It provides good nutrition and helps you to stay healthy!
Bravo~bravo~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
南瓜是上帝赐予我们的礼物。
它提供丰富的营养，帮助你保持健康！
好极了~好极了~！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I, Hoirin have always thought about a 
way to eat pumpkin more deliciously.
But all of a sudden, I realized.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我，霍伊琳，一直在思考
如何更美味地食用南瓜。
但突然间，我意识到了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
If I have that! I can make best the Pumpkin pie!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果我有那个！我就能做出最好的南瓜派！！！！！

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
What's the first image you see when you think of pumpkin?
I see Jack! I think Jack is the most evolved form of pumpkin!
I wonder what does Jack have something special? Can you imagine?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
当你想到南瓜时，你看到的第一个形象是什么？
我看到的是杰克！我认为杰克是南瓜的最高进化形态！
我想知道杰克有什么特别之处？你能想象吗？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I always prefer unique pumpkin dish! Recently, I found out that there are many kinds of Jack in the world 
and the extreme class Jack has blue aura around his body!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我总是喜欢独特的南瓜料理！最近，我发现世界上有很多种杰克，
而顶级职业的杰克身体周围环绕着蓝色的<死亡骑士>灵气！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Guess what?! it was Halloween Jack!
Halloween Jack has somthing that is concentrated with pumpkin.
It is called ^4d4dffPumpkin Mojo^000000. Only if i have it, i can finish making my special pie.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
猜猜怎么着？！那是万圣节杰克！
万圣节杰克拥有一种浓缩了南瓜精华的东西。
它叫做^4d4dff南瓜的精髓^000000。只要我有它，我就能完成我的特色派。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Bring me the ingredients!
I'll make you a very special pie right away!
You'll get addicted to it.
Don't be surprised after trying it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
把材料带给我！
我会立刻为你制作一份非常特别的派！
你会对它上瘾的。
尝过之后别太惊讶哦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
......................
You seem to be such a passionate person.
So, what's the ingredient anyway.?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
......................
你看起来真是个充满热情的人。
那么，到底是什么材料呢？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Good question!
To make my special Pumpkin pie, I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
问得好！
要制作我的特色南瓜派，我需要
^4d4dff 1个南瓜的精髓
2个南瓜
2个鸡蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Just Bring Pumpkin Mojo, Pumpkin, and a Egg.
Leave the rest for me..You'll get to try the best pumkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
只要带来南瓜的精髓、南瓜和鸡蛋。
剩下的交给我..你会尝到最棒的南瓜派！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Hm..You'll regret it!
Hoirin's pumpkin pie is just so delicious.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
哼..你会后悔的！
霍伊琳的南瓜派可是非常美味的。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
So, did you bring all materials?
Were there anything hard to find?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
那么，你把所有材料都带来了吗？
有什么难找的东西吗？

scripts.text: I brought all ingredients.
scripts.translation: 我带来了所有材料。

scripts.text: How can I get eggs?
scripts.translation: 我怎么才能得到鸡蛋？

scripts.text: No,I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
You are right!
You brought all things right. Give it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你说得对！
你把所有东西都带对了。给我吧！！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Abracadabra~~
Abracadabra~~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
阿布拉卡达布拉~~
阿布拉卡达布拉~~！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ta-da(h)!
Here it is~ help yourself.
It'll be good for your health. I added extra nutrient in it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
当当当(h)！
在这里~请自便。
这对你的健康有好处。我在里面加了额外的营养。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
No!! This is not enough. I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
 at least.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
不！！这还不够。我至少需要
^4d4dff 1个南瓜的精髓
2个南瓜
2个鸡蛋^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Egg?
Well, actually I know someone who can help you.
There's a man who raise many chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
鸡蛋？
嗯，其实我知道有人可以帮你。
有个养了很多小鸡的男子。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I can send you to where he is if you want.
^4d4dffBut only for once^000000.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果你愿意，我可以送你去他那里。
^4d4dff但只有一次^000000。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我去。

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ok, go get the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
好的，去拿鸡蛋吧。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Do you think you can go without my help?!
Ok! go ahead.
Do you know where it is?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你觉得没有我的帮助你能去吗？！
好吧！去吧。
你知道在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
if you go to ^4d4dfffarm of Skelington Town at Neiflheim^000000, you'll meet Chicken Masta. He raises chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果你去^4d4dff尼福尔海姆的骷髅镇的农场^000000，你会遇到炸鸡大师。他养小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Next time, don't forget to bring 
all the ingredients for pumpkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
下次，别忘了带上
制作南瓜派的所有材料！

[Deviruchi]
Hey there, if you have something to say to Loli Ruri, talk to me.
She's not used to human language.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嘿，如果你有什么话想对萝莉·露莉说，就跟我讲。
她不习惯人类的语言。

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi~Where's the pumpkin pie?
Humans make them, don't they?
Do you have it then?
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
小恶魔~南瓜派在哪里？
人类会做这个，对吧？
你有吗？
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
If you have a pumpinkin pie, can I have one?
Cause we are the victim if Loli Ruri gets mad.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
如果你有南瓜派，能给我一个吗？
因为如果萝莉·露莉生气，我们就是受害者。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well I'm not saying that I want it for free.
Don't worry, I won't let you down.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嗯，我不是说我想白拿。
别担心，我不会让你失望的。

scripts.text: Give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 给他南瓜派。

scripts.text: Do not give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 不给他南瓜派。

scripts.text: Huh? What pumkin pie?
scripts.translation: 哈？什么南瓜派？

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Thanks for the pumkin pie!
Here, take this.
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
谢谢你的南瓜派！
给，拿着这个。
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
As I promised, I'll give you something worth the pie.
Hang on....
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
正如我承诺的，我会给你与派等值的东西。
稍等....

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hmm...This would be good.
Here take this, and thanks again~
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嗯...这个应该不错。
拿着这个，再次感谢~

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Are you kidding me?
Where's the pumpkin pie! Don't try to lie to me!
 
[Deviruchi]
Say she..Seems like she's very angry...You are in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
你在开玩笑吗？
南瓜派在哪里！别想骗我！
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的..她看起来非常生气...你有麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi!!!!!You are the one who told me that I can get the pumpkin pie if I stand here and wait.
Watch your back!
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she..Huh?!!Me?!!
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
小恶魔!!!!!是你告诉我站在这里等就能拿到南瓜派的。
小心背后！
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的..哈？！！我？！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Wish you a luck.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可怜的小恶魔~
你不该撒谎的~
祝你好运。

我想吃南瓜派。能给我一个吗？求求你了~~~~
 
[小恶魔]
他是这么说的.....如果你有就给我。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
There's a man who makes a very special pumpkin pie.
No one can forget what it taste like.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
有个人做的南瓜派非常特别。
没人能忘记它的味道。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Lori Ruri is waiting here for someone who will get the pie for him.
Can you get her one?

scripts.translation:

萝莉·露莉在这里等着有人给她拿派来。

我会回报你的。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Where did the chicken have gone?!
Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
小鸡都跑到哪里去了？！
哦，嘿，陌生人。我能帮你什么忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
This town is too dangerous for you to hang around.
You'd better go back to where you came from....
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这个城镇对你来说太危险了，不适合闲逛。
你最好回到你来的地方....

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
...Are you looking for eggs?
Recently, people are asking me for eggs to make some kind of pie....are you one of them?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
...你在找鸡蛋吗？
最近，人们向我要鸡蛋去做某种派....你是其中之一吗？

scripts.text: Actually, yes. I came here to get some eggs.
scripts.translation: 实际上，是的。我来这里是为了买些鸡蛋。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Ok. But some of my chickens ran away,
so I have no eggs much left.
1000 zeny for 2 eggs! how's that?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
好的。但是我的一些小鸡跑掉了，
所以我没剩下多少鸡蛋了。
2个鸡蛋1000泽尼！怎么样？

scripts.text: Ok,I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要了。

scripts.text: I'll just buy one.
scripts.translation: 我只买一个。

scripts.text: Whew~it's too expensive.
scripts.translation: 呼~太贵了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
谢谢。
这是鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Hey this is not enough~
1000zeny per each, so if you buy two,that means 2000zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
嘿，这不够~
每个1000泽尼，所以如果你买两个，那就是2000泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
谢谢。
这是鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough money...
It's 1000 zeny per each.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你似乎没有足够的钱...
每个1000泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Well...I know it's liitle bit expensive but as I told you, my chickens ran away.
You have to understand.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
嗯...我知道有点贵，但正如我告诉你的，我的小鸡跑掉了。
你得理解。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Let me tell you just one thing!
If you don't want to die,
you'd better run away. It's too dangerous in here.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我只告诉你一件事！
如果你不想死，
你最好快跑。这里太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Do you need eggs?...
Then, help me first.
8 of my chickens ran away.
I just don't know where they are.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你需要鸡蛋吗？...
那么，先帮帮我。
我的8只小鸡跑掉了。
我不知道它们在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I don't expect all chickens to come back home.
Only if you find me one of them, I'll sell three eggs for you.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我不指望所有小鸡都回家。
只要你帮我找到其中一只，我就卖给你三个鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Isn't it a great deal?
Chickens must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这不是笔好交易吗？
小鸡肯定就在附近的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to bring back chickens to me if you find one,
Just insert the word ^4d4dff'Return'^000000.
.........
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
如果你找到一只，不必把小鸡带回来给我，
只要输入单词^4d4dff‘Return’^000000。
.........

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
It's a spell to make chickens to go back home.
.........
Don't forget the word 'Return'!
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这是一个让小鸡回家的咒语。
.........
别忘了单词‘Return’！

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I hope you can find my chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
希望你能找到我的小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Oh, you came back. I've been waiting for you.
And thanks for the chickens you sent me.
They are saftly kept in the henhouse, in case of running away again.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
哦，你回来了。我一直在等你。
谢谢你送我回来的小鸡。
为了防止它们再次逃跑，它们被安全地关在鸡舍里。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I didn't forget what we have promised.
Tell me how many eggs you want.
It's 1000zeny per each.
And maximum 3 is all you can get.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我没忘记我们的约定。
告诉我你想要多少个鸡蛋。
每个1000泽尼。
最多只能买3个。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to buy it, if you don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
如果你不需要，可以不买。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
What did I tell you.
I'm going to sell only three eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我跟你说过什么。
我只卖三个鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你似乎没有足够的泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Here you are.
But no more.
If you want more eggs, find me more chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
给你。
但不能再多了。
如果你想要更多鸡蛋，就帮我找更多小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Where did the chicken have gone?!
Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
小鸡都跑到哪里去了？！
哦，嘿，陌生人。我能帮你什么忙吗？

scripts.text:

This town is too dangerous for you to hang around.
You'd better go back to where you came from....
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这个城镇对你来说太危险了，不适合闲逛。
你最好回到你来的地方....

scripts.text: Drowsing chicken.
scripts.translation: 打盹的小鸡。

scripts.text:
Oh, this must be Chicken Masta's chicken.
I should insert the magic word.
scripts.translation:
哦，这一定是炸鸡大师的小鸡。
我应该输入那个魔法单词。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Hello.
I'm Loli Ruri's faithful and cute Familiar.
Do you have an invitation from Loli Ruri?
That's a kind of^4d4dffa special ticket to Niflheim^000000..
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你好。
我是萝莉·露莉忠诚又可爱的使魔。
你有萝莉·露莉的邀请函吗？
那是^4d4dff一种前往尼福尔海姆的特殊门票^000000..

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有。

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Do you want to go to Niflheim?
It's available during Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你想去尼福尔海姆吗？
这在万圣节期间可用。

scripts.text: Yes, I do
scripts.translation: 是的，我想

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
I checked your ticket.
You can go there now
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
我检查了你的门票。
你现在可以去那里了

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
You're a liar.
You don't have the ticket!
I'll suck up all your blood, you liar!
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你是个骗子。
你没有门票！
我要吸干你的血，你这个骗子！

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
Actually, it's useless to have a special ticket to Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好的。
实际上，拥有前往尼福尔海姆的特殊门票也没什么用。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
If you want to ask something, give a piece of pumpkin pie to Loli Ruri.
He likes it.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好的。
如果你想问什么问题，给萝莉·露莉一块南瓜派。
他喜欢这个。
